summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K announcing the second tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, up to USD 375 million, commencing after the AGM on 12 May 2026. Shares will be repurchased at prices between NOK 50 and NOK 1,000 per share. The buy-back includes up to USD 123.8 million in open-market purchases and the balance via redemption from the Norwegian State, reducing issued capital. Shares purchased will be cancelled in May 2027. A non-discretionary third-party agreement ensures independence. This is an open-market capital return programme, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private.
